label: Total holder: the sole, non-reciprocal present actualizer of another in a respect
term: total holder, totally holds in a respect (Lean `TotallyHolds`)
definition: TotallyHolds H z x r: z is other than x, z presently actualizes x in respect r (Holding.ActualizesNow, definition 6ab9a832-6b0f-47ac-9f08-144444bf1cb1), every w that presently actualizes x in r is z (sole holder: no other present actualizer of x in r), and x does not presently actualize z in r (non-reciprocal: no reciprocal present actualization in r). Defined from the primitive holding relation; nothing further is primitive. Ordinary meaning: a hook from which a lamp hangs and on which nothing else bears the lamp, while the lamp does not prop the hook. Not total: each of two cards leaning on each other (each also held by the floor, and each holding the other back), and each of two walls that together carry a beam. Distinguished from holding simpliciter (several holders of one act are allowed there), from MOTION_3 holding motion (definition ea1904bc-bdfa-4835-a4a7-8545c5221e2e, which concerns the held thing and needs only some holder), and from the Thomist 'total cause in its own order' (primary and secondary causes each wholly producing one effect, SCG III.70, not read; navigation only), which is order-relative and is not this sense: under this sense, two holders of one act in one respect exclude each other's totality whatever their orders.
note: Analyst notion, attribution deferred: the repair named in docs/notes/caused-mover-cstar.md, section 9.2, formalized in section 10. Structural facts: irreflexive by its distinctness clause; asymmetric in one respect (the non-reciprocity clause); at most one total holder of a given x in a given r (the sole clause). It is not assumed transitive. Only direct reciprocity is excluded: a three-step cycle of total holders in one respect is not excluded by the definition. Would be sourced by a pinned passage distinguishing a whole cause of a present act from co-causes and from reciprocal causes.
